proposals.before: We shall eat raw flesh and drink blood beneath the three luminaries; High Heaven grants us leave to sweep away the scourge, enthrone Daowen as king, and install Jiang as inner mistress.
proposals.after: Chewing hair and drinking blood beneath the three luminaries, High Heaven permits it; we shall sweep away the harm, establish Daowen as king, and make Jiang the inner ruler.
proposals.reason: Restore the oath imagery, Daowen and Jiang in the forged document; Hu Sanxing reads the oath as a covenant. The division of 許/當 and modal force remain interpretive; exact-field independent decision and reconciliation are required.

proposals.before: Heaven blesses our coup—crown Daowen, empower Lady Jiang.
proposals.after: Beneath the sun, moon, and stars, we pledge with hair and blood: Heaven gives its leave, and we shall sweep away the danger, make Daowen king, and make Jiang ruler of the inner court.
proposals.reason: Restore the oath imagery, Daowen and Jiang in the forged document; Hu Sanxing reads the oath as a covenant. The division of 許/當 and modal force remain interpretive; exact-field independent decision and reconciliation are required.
